description: This file defines the Mpdf class, a writer implementation for exporting spreadsheets to PDF format using the mPDF library within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It includes methods for creating an external PDF library instance, saving the spreadsheet to a PDF file, and converting measurement units.

classes.name: Mpdf
classes.description: A class for writing PDF files from spreadsheets using the mPDF external library within the PhpSpreadsheet framework.

methods.name: createExternalWriterInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of the external mPDF library based on provided configuration.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current spreadsheet as a PDF file to the specified filename, configuring page setup, document info, and rendering HTML content into the PDF.

methods.name: inchesToMm
methods.description: Converts measurement from inches to millimeters.
